offense_penalties.name: False Start
offense_penalties.text: PENALTY: False Start! The offensive line twitched pre-snap. Loss of 5 yards, repeat the down.

offense_penalties.name: Offensive Pass Interference
offense_penalties.text: PENALTY: Offensive Pass Interference! Receiver pushed off at the break. Loss of 10 yards, repeat the down.

offense_penalties.name: Illegal Flag Shielding
offense_penalties.text: PENALTY: Flag Guarding! Runner swatted away the defender's hand. Loss of 5 yards from the spot.

defense_penalties.name: Offside / Encroachment
defense_penalties.text: PENALTY: Defensive Offside! Rusher crossed the 7-yard rush line early. 5 yard penalty, repeat down.

defense_penalties.name: Defensive Pass Interference
defense_penalties.text: PENALTY: Defensive Pass Interference! Cornerback tackled the receiver before the ball arrived! 10 yard penalty, automatic first down!

defense_penalties.name: Illegal Contact / Holding
defense_penalties.text: PENALTY: Defensive Holding! Corner grabbing jersey downfield. 5 yard penalty, repeat down.
